stem.en: A drumhead goes to and fro 15 times in 3 seconds, at a steady rate. If it keeps the same rate, how many times does it go to and fro in 10 seconds?

explanation.en: 15 times in 3 s is 15 / 3 = 5 times every second. In 10 s it is 5 x 10 = 50 times.

hints.en: Work out how many to-and-fro motions happen in one second, then multiply by 10.
15 in 3 seconds means 5 in every second.
